title: The cohomology projection of an arbitrary two-term coimage complex is a quasi-isomorphism
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be abelian [def-sp-abelian], $K,M$ cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and $q\in\mathbf Z$. Suppose $M^r$ is zero for $r\ne q-1,q$, with isomorphisms $e_0:M^{q-1}\cong\operatorname{coker}(\ker d_K^{q-1}\hookrightarrow K^{q-1})$ and $e_1:M^q\cong\ker d_K^q$. Let $\pi$ be the coimage projection. Assume $d_M^{q-1}$ is mono and $(\ker d_K^q\hookrightarrow K^q)e_1d_M^{q-1}e_0^{-1}\pi=d_K^{q-1}$. Let $b:M\to H^q(K)[-q]$ be a chain map such that its degree-q component, after precomposing with $e_1^{-1}$ and identifying the degree-q object of the single complex with $H^q(K)$, is the canonical projection $\rho:\ker d_K^q\to H^q(K)$. Then $b$ is a quasi-isomorphism.

proof.text: For r different from q, the target single complex has zero term and is exact. For r also different from q-1, M has zero term and is exact. At q-1 the incoming differential is zero since M^(q-2) is zero, and the outgoing differential is mono by hm, so ShortComplex.exact_iff_mono proves exactness. quasiIsoAt_iff_exactAt' proves the comparison in these degrees.

Cancel the mono K.iCycles q in hd to identify the corestriction of the incoming differential with K.toCycles (q-1) q. Let T be the short complex K.X(q-1) -> K.cycles q -> K.homology q; HomologicalComplex.homologyIsCokernel and ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel prove T exact. Let S be M.X(q-1) -> M.X q -> (single q (K.homology q)).X q, whose second arrow is b.f q. The chain-map equation and the zero target term at q-1 prove S is a short complex. Construct T -> S with components the coimage projection followed by e0.inv, e1.inv, and singleObjXSelf.inv. Its squares commute by hd and hb. These components are epi, iso, and mono, respectively; ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono transfers exactness to S.

Since K.homologyπ q is epi, hb and cancellation of isomorphisms show b.f q is epi. The outgoing differential of M at q is zero because M.X(q+1) is zero. Both adjacent terms of the single complex are zero. Apply ShortComplex.quasiIso_iff_of_zeros' to S.Exact and Epi (b.f q), transported with quasiIsoAt_iff', to obtain the comparison at q. Assemble all degrees by quasiIso_iff.

lean.statement:
theorem twoTermCoimage_quasiIso
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (K M : CochainComplex C ℤ) (q : ℤ)
    (hM : ∀ r : ℤ, r ≠ q - 1 → r ≠ q → IsZero (M.X r))
    (e₀ : M.X (q - 1) ≅ cokernel (kernel.ι (K.d (q - 1) q)))
    (e₁ : M.X q ≅ K.cycles q)
    (hd : cokernel.π (kernel.ι (K.d (q - 1) q)) ≫ e₀.inv ≫
      M.d (q - 1) q ≫ e₁.hom ≫ K.iCycles q = K.d (q - 1) q)
    (hm : Mono (M.d (q - 1) q))
    (b : M ⟶ (singleFunctor C q).obj (K.homology q))
    (hb : e₁.inv ≫ b.f q ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) q (K.homology q)).hom =
      K.homologyπ q) : QuasiIso b
